newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline slips with crude, sharp NYMEX losses.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline slips with crude, sharp NYMEX losses.

text.p: Gasoline lost up to $2 a tonne on Monday, knocked lower by easier crude, sharply lower U.S gasoline futures and lacklustre local demand.
Traders said Eurograde barges traded down to $214.50 fob AR and $215 late after early deals of $219.50 and $222.

Bearish Euroil gasoline stock data released on Monday that showed a build of 4.5 million barrels helped contribute to the weaker tone which was set by NYMEX February gasoline losing about two cents a gallon. U.S demand was still evident, although high freight costs and sparse tonnage availability was making it difficult for charterers to use tankers on the spot market.
MTBE was quiet on Monday with Jan barges pegged around $288-289.
